heading: top-center
name: 三欄圖文卡片網格＋圖示面板（按鈕跨在面板下緣）
desc: 上方置中標題組，下方每列三張卡片：上半是置中完整顯示的圖片區，分隔線下是小標籤、標題連結與說明文字；網格下方一張橫跨內容寬度的面板，放一列小圖示項目，主要按鈕跨在面板下緣中央。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊上方置中放標題組；標題組包含標題（可多行），下方可放副標，沒有時省略。標題組下方是多個項目排成的網格，對齊頁面內容寬度，每列三個等寬的項目，同一列等高。每個項目是一張卡片：上方是一塊橫式的圖片區，約佔卡片高度四成，圖片在區內置中、完整顯示且明顯小於圖片區，周圍留空白；圖片區和下方文字區之間有一條橫向分隔線，橫跨整張卡片寬；文字區靠左，由上而下是小標籤、帶箭頭的文字連結形式的標題（可多行）、說明文字（可多行），小標籤與說明文字沒有時省略。網格下方放一張橫跨頁面內容寬度的面板卡片：面板內上方置中放一行小標題，下方一列多個項目平均分布，每個項目是置中的小圖示加下方的短說明文字；面板下緣中央放一個主要按鈕，按鈕跨在面板下緣上，約一半在面板內、一半在面板外。面板、圖示列與跨在面板下緣的主要按鈕都是這個版型的必要部分，一定要做出來。
tablet: 平板網格改為每列兩個項目，其他沿用桌機版。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：標題組仍在上方置中；網格改為每列一個項目，卡片內部結構不變（圖片區在上、分隔線、文字區在下）。面板內的小標題仍置中（可多行），圖示項目改為每列四個、排成多列；主要按鈕仍跨在面板下緣中央。觸控裝置上取消滑過卡片的效果。

en.name: Three-column image-and-text card grid + icon panel (button straddling the panel's bottom edge)
en.desc: A centered heading group on top, then three cards per row: the upper half is an image area with a centered image shown in full, and below a divider are a label, a title link and a description; under the grid, a panel spanning the content width holds a row of small icon items, with a primary button straddling the center of the panel's bottom edge.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Place the heading group at the top, centered; the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a subheading below; omit it when there is no content. Below the heading group is a grid of multiple items aligned to the page content width, with three equal-width items per row and items in the same row of equal height. Each item is a card: at the top is a landscape image area taking about forty percent of the card's height, with the image centered in it, shown in full and clearly smaller than the area, leaving empty space around it; a horizontal divider spanning the full card width separates the image area from the text area below; the text area is aligned left and contains, from top to bottom, a label, a title styled as a text link with an arrow (may wrap to multiple lines), and a description (may wrap to multiple lines); omit the label and description when there is no content. Below the grid is a panel card spanning the page content width: inside the panel, a short title is centered at the top, and below it a row of multiple items is evenly distributed, each item being a centered small icon with a short caption below it; a primary button sits at the center of the panel's bottom edge, straddling that edge with about half inside the panel and half outside. The panel, its row of icon items and the primary button straddling its bottom edge are required parts of this layout and must always be built.
en.tablet: On tablet the grid changes to two items per row; everything else uses the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Changes to a vertical stack: the heading group stays centered at the top; the grid changes to one item per row, with the card's inner structure unchanged (image area on top, divider, text area below). Inside the panel the short title stays centered (may wrap to multiple lines), and the icon items change to four per row across multiple rows; the primary button still straddles the center of the panel's bottom edge. On touch devices the card hover effect is removed.

extras.name: 滑過卡片時文字區變色並浮起
extras.prompt: 網格裡的卡片在滑鼠停留時，卡片下方的文字區換成較深的底色，整張卡片微微浮起；滑開後恢復。
extras.mobile: 觸控裝置上取消這個效果，卡片維持一般狀態，點擊直接前往連結。

en.name: Card text area changes color and lifts on hover
en.prompt: When the pointer rests on a card in the grid, the text area in the lower part of the card switches to a darker background and the whole card lifts slightly; it returns to normal when the pointer leaves.
en.mobile: On touch devices this effect is removed; cards stay in their normal state and tapping goes straight to the link.
